# Data Visualization


```{r}
wvs_ru = wvs %>%
  filter(B_COUNTRY_ALPHA == "RUS") %>%
  filter(Q108 > 0)

ggplot(wvs %>% filter(Q108 > 0, B_COUNTRY_ALPHA == "RUS")) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = Q108))
```



191 and 194 correlations

```{r}
wvs_byc = wvs %>%
  group_by(B_COUNTRY_ALPHA) %>%
  filter(Q108 > 0,
         Q194 > 0) %>%
  summarize(Q108 = mean(Q108),
            Q194 = mean(Q194))

ggplot(wvs_byc) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Q108, y = Q194))

cor(wvs_byc$Q194, wvs_byc$Q108)
```
